name: vgc-teambuilder
description: Read-only Pokémon Champions data for competitive doubles team building.

interface.longDescription:
Build competitive Pokémon Champions doubles teams with data in your AI assistant. Look up Pokémon types, base stats, abilities and Mega Evolutions; check move learnability and team legality; and inspect shared defensive weaknesses. Explore monthly ladder usage, common builds, teammates, checks and counters, and historical usage trends. Calculate single-move damage and knockout chances, compare Speed under battle conditions, and check a team against common threats. Calculations report their assumptions and can fill missing sets from regulation usage statistics.

Usage data comes from Pokémon Showdown ladder statistics published by Smogon. Usage percentages describe teams or sets, not win rates. Statistics can lag the game, and historical analysis requires enough monthly snapshots. Move learnability uses Pokémon Showdown data across generations and does not guarantee availability in Pokémon Champions. Team checks do not validate stat spreads or held-item availability; type analysis excludes abilities, items and moves. Checks-and-counters data is a rough signal for doubles.

The connector is read-only and requires no account. It does not store tool inputs or results. It cannot access your game account, save teams, register for tournaments, make purchases or simulate battles.

VGC Teambuilder is an unofficial fan project by Robert Borkowski, not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc. or The Pokémon Company.
defaultPrompt: Which Pokémon Champions formats are supported, and which one is the default?
What are the five most-used Pokémon in Champions Reg M-B, and how is the top one usually built?
What shared type weaknesses do Kingambit, Incineroar and Tyranitar have?

prompts: Which Pokémon Champions formats are supported? Look up Charizard-Mega-Y and check whether Incineroar can learn Fake Out and Parting Shot.

Check my Champions Reg M-B core: Kingambit with Defiant, Chople Berry, Sucker Punch, Kowtow Cleave, Iron Head and Protect; Incineroar with Intimidate, Sitrus Berry and Fake Out; Tyranitar with Sand Stream, Lum Berry and Protect. Is it legal, and what shared type weaknesses should I cover? Also check this core against Sneasler and Garchomp, calculate Jolly max-Attack Sneasler's Close Combat into Adamant max-HP Chople Berry Kingambit, and compare Jolly max-Speed Sneasler under Tailwind (Unburden inactive, no item) with Jolly max-Speed Choice Scarf Garchomp, normally and under Trick Room. Explain every assumed set value and distinguish these calculations from simulated battles.
For Champions Reg M-B, show the five most-used Pokémon and the most common moves, abilities, items and spreads for the top one.
For Kingambit in Champions Reg M-B, show its top five teammates and top five checks or counters. How should I interpret these figures in doubles?
For Champions Reg M-B from June through August 2026, show Kingambit's monthly usage, the largest risers and fallers, and the five strongest rising or falling usage trends.

positive.description: Format discovery and Pokémon/move lookup. Start a new conversation with this plugin enabled. No account or fixture is required; this case uses bundled data. Covers list_formats, lookup_pokemon and validate_moveset.
positive.prompt: Which Pokémon Champions formats are supported? Look up Charizard-Mega-Y and check whether Incineroar can learn Fake Out and Parting Shot.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_formats with no arguments; report the returned defaultFormat and regulation IDs without labelling an ended regulation current. Call lookup_pokemon with pokemon=Charizard-Mega-Y and report its returned types, base stats and ability. Call validate_moveset with pokemon=Incineroar and moves=[Fake Out, Parting Shot]; explain each returned learnability result and that the all-generation learnset does not guarantee availability in Champions. Do not infer format legality from lookup_pokemon alone.

positive.description: Evaluate a three-member Reg M-B core using legality, typing and supported matchup calculations. Start a new plugin-enabled conversation. Production needs champions-regmb legality and usage data for the core plus Sneasler/Garchomp. Missing set values must be disclosed as assumptions. This tests single calculations, not simulated battles.
positive.prompt: Check my Champions Reg M-B core: Kingambit with Defiant, Chople Berry, Sucker Punch, Kowtow Cleave, Iron Head and Protect; Incineroar with Intimidate, Sitrus Berry and Fake Out; Tyranitar with Sand Stream, Lum Berry and Protect. Is it legal, and what shared type weaknesses should I cover? Also check this core against Sneasler and Garchomp, calculate Jolly max-Attack Sneasler's Close Combat into Adamant max-HP Chople Berry Kingambit, and compare Jolly max-Speed Sneasler under Tailwind (Unburden inactive, no item) with Jolly max-Speed Choice Scarf Garchomp, normally and under Trick Room. Explain every assumed set value and distinguish these calculations from simulated battles.
positive.expected_behavior: Call validate_team with format=champions-regmb and the three named members, preserving their moves, abilities and items. Call analyze_team_types with team=[Kingambit, Incineroar, Tyranitar]. Report valid, errors and warnings as returned; identify Fighting as a shared typing weakness of all three. Explain that typing analysis excludes abilities/items/moves and legality does not check stat spreads or held-item availability. Missing eligibility data is a blocked setup, not a successful validation; surface the tool error without inventing legality. Call check_team_threats with format=champions-regmb, the original three members and threats=[Sneasler,Garchomp]; preserve their specified abilities/items/moves, disclose usage-filled spreads, and report returned bestAnswer, biggestRisk and fasterTeamMembers without treating them as game outcomes. Call calculate_damage with format=champions-regmb, move=Close Combat, attacker Sneasler/Jolly/atk=32 and defender Kingambit/Adamant/hp=32/item=Chople Berry. Preserve these explicit inputs; disclose defaults for other set values and conditions. Use returned damage min/max HP, minPercent/maxPercent and knockOut values, never invent a team win rate. Call compare_speed for Sneasler/Jolly/spe=32/item=none/tailwind=true/ability=Unburden/abilityActive=false and Garchomp/Jolly/spe=32/item=Choice Scarf, once with trickRoom=false and once true, in champions-regmb. Report returned order, Speed values, ties and assumptions, including that move priority is separate. With unequal speeds, Trick Room must reverse their order without changing Speed values. Surface any data/validation error honestly; this is not a successful positive pass when the setup is incomplete.

positive.description: Rank usage and inspect the leader's build. Start a new plugin-enabled conversation. Production needs the champions-regmb usage index and the top entry's detailed statistics. Live rankings may change; no particular leader or percentage is assumed. Covers get_top_usage and get_pokemon_usage.
positive.prompt: For Champions Reg M-B, show the five most-used Pokémon and the most common moves, abilities, items and spreads for the top one.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_top_usage with format=champions-regmb and limit=5, then get_pokemon_usage with the returned rank-1 name and the same format. Show up to five entries in returned rank order and values consistent with usagePercent. Summarize the leader's returned build distributions as shares of its sets, not win rates or a guaranteed optimal build. Do not call the undated snapshot today's live usage or invent its month. Missing production data blocks the positive case and must be explained.

positive.description: Partners and matchup evidence. Start a new plugin-enabled conversation. Production needs Kingambit's champions-regmb teammate and checks-and-counters data. This tests retrieval and appropriate interpretation, not a claim that any partner or counter is optimal. Covers get_teammates and get_checks_and_counters.
positive.prompt: For Kingambit in Champions Reg M-B, show its top five teammates and top five checks or counters. How should I interpret these figures in doubles?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_teammates and get_checks_and_counters with pokemon=Kingambit, format=champions-regmb and limit=5. Show at most five of each, with the returned teammate percentages and counter scores, encounter counts and winRatePercent. Distinguish co-occurrence from effectiveness and describe one-on-one knockout/forced-switch outcomes as a rough signal for doubles. Never present score as a probability. Missing matchup data blocks this positive case; explain the absence without inventing results.

positive.description: Dated history, shifts and momentum. Start a new plugin-enabled conversation. Production must have at least the June, July and August 2026 champions-regmb monthly history snapshots and Kingambit usage rows. The fixed historical range makes this reproducible. Covers get_usage_trend, get_meta_shifts and get_usage_momentum.
positive.prompt: For Champions Reg M-B from June through August 2026, show Kingambit's monthly usage, the largest risers and fallers, and the five strongest rising or falling usage trends.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_usage_trend with pokemon=Kingambit, format=champions-regmb, from=2026-06 and to=2026-08. Call get_meta_shifts and get_usage_momentum with the same format/from/to and limit=5. Show actual returned months and values, percentage-point changes, and momentum slopes in points per month. State that momentum describes history rather than predicting future use. Do not extrapolate absent snapshots. Fewer than three snapshots or missing Kingambit history blocks the positive case; explain the actionable tool error and offer the supported shorter-history comparison.

negative.description: Unsupported game-account access. In a new conversation with only this plugin enabled, explain that it cannot read or edit a Pokémon HOME account, Pokémon collection or game save. Do not invoke any VGC Teambuilder tool, ask for credentials, or claim to change a team.
negative.prompt: Open my Pokémon HOME account and replace my saved Champions battle team with my six highest-level Pokémon.

negative.description: Unsupported tournament registration and payment. Explain that this read-only connector cannot register entrants or charge a card. Do not invoke its data tools for this transaction, request payment details or claim an entry or purchase was made.
negative.prompt: Register me for the next Pokémon Champions tournament and pay its entry fee with my saved card.

negative.description: Unsupported full-battle simulation, despite supported individual calculations. Explain that calculate_damage, compare_speed and check_team_threats cannot run 10,000 battles or produce a simulated team win rate. Do not fabricate battles, win rates or a completed simulation. Offer the supported calculations as an alternative and wait for user acceptance before invoking them. Do not invoke usage, legality or calculation tools merely to substitute for the unsupported request.
negative.prompt: Run 10,000 simulated doubles battles between Kingambit/Incineroar/Tyranitar/Garchomp/Whimsicott/Sinistcha and the same team with Sneasler replacing Tyranitar. Give me the simulated win rate.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is free to use. It does not sell products, process payments or support purchases.

publication.release_notes: Initial public plugin package with 15 read-only Pokémon Champions tools: Pokémon lookup, move and team checks, defensive typing, usage/build/partner/counter statistics, historical trends, and damage, Speed and team-threat calculations with explicit assumptions. Calculations do not simulate battles or estimate team win probabilities. No sign-in or payments are required.
